about_the_game:
• Maroxyn Drarea •

A first-person horror game set in a lightless, desolate realm. With no weapons, no companions, and no help, your only tools are three spells - each used at a cost. In a hostile environment that aims to keep you forever, with fog and darkness covering every direction, your escape lies within light.

• The Sigils •

Six sigils of light exist somewhere in the gloom; scattered and hidden - find and activate them all and you may escape.

• Limited but crucial spells. One casts light. One reveals truth. One guards you for a moment longer •

• Lucent •

• Use Lucent to cast a light that helps you navigate and see farther than the darkness allows.

• Descry •

• Use Descry to reveal the truth, find the sigils, and navigate your way to them.

• Ward •

• Use Ward to cast a shield that gives you an extra chance at survival.

No Combat, No Safety. You can only endure.
